items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Searchable select on Base UI Combobox: single value or multiple with chips (Backspace removes), clear, trigger, groups, empty state; selected rows show a filled square bullet (ItemIndicator). IME-safe.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Single: Combobox > ComboboxInputGroup (ComboboxInput, ComboboxClear, ComboboxTrigger) + ComboboxContent > ComboboxEmpty + ComboboxList > ComboboxItem. Multiple: add `multiple` and put ComboboxChips (ComboboxChip + ComboboxChipRemove + ComboboxInput) inside the group via ComboboxValue. Also ComboboxLabel, Group/GroupLabel/Separator, Status, Row, Collection, Backdrop, Arrow, useComboboxFilter. Give each ComboboxChip an aria-label and each ComboboxChipRemove a label naming its value. v4 (yorha-v4/f-sel-a): `<Combobox loading>` puts a Spinner in the trigger cell (chevron hidden, same box), keeps previous rows at 60 % opacity with aria-busy on the list, and ComboboxStatus reads "불러오는 중" unless it has children. `ComboboxCreate` (mount once in the content; flat `items` only) adds a "text 만들기" option while the input has unmatched text: `onCreate(text)`, `exists`, children label; keep `value` controlled. The +N chip is now a <button> (was role=img) that opens the popup. Esc with the popup closed clears typed text and does not bubble; an empty field lets Esc bubble. Arrow is a four-glyph pixel triangle (no rotation). Migration: `Combobox` is now a function wrapper (generic, owns `open`: pass `open`/`onOpenChange` as before); registryDependencies add @yorha/glyph and @yorha/spinner.
